name: Dom naroda Parlamenta Federacije BiH
notes: House of Peoples of the FBiH Parliament (80 delegates). No seat chart: no current official delegate list could be read (the parlamentfbih.gov.ba delegate page still shows the 2014-2018 term) and the register's one delegate, Aner Žuljević, is not verified as sitting.

name: Predstavnički dom Parlamentarne skupštine BiH (House of Representatives)
notes: 42 seats (28 from the Federation, 14 from Republika Srpska), the 2022-2026 term. Members and parties from the Parliamentary Assembly's own list of representatives (parlament.ba/representative/list); the party is the badge on the list, and 'No party shown' where it has none. General elections were held in October 2026; this is the outgoing house until the new one is constituted. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Dom naroda Parlamentarne skupštine BiH (House of Peoples)
notes: 15 seats (5 delegates for each constituent people), the 2022-2026 term. Delegates and parties from the Parliamentary Assembly's own list (parlament.ba/delegate/list); a delegate who has left shows as former with the end date. General elections were held in October 2026; this is the outgoing house until the new one is constituted. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Predstavnički dom Parlamenta Federacije BiH (FBiH House of Representatives)
notes: 98 seats, the 2022-2026 term. Members and their party are from the House's own list of representatives (predstavnickidom-pfbih.gov.ba/zastupnici), which groups them by party; it gives no constituency or start date. Outgoing house until the result of the October 2026 elections is constituted. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
